fns.desc: macsec_qca_init_sockets() opens drv->common.sock and registers it with eloop_register_read_sock(), then on every later failure (SIOCGIFINDEX ioctl :212-216, bind :224-228, multicast join :231-236, SIOCGIFHWADDR ioctl :240-244, bad hw-addr family :246-250) returns -1 without close(drv->common.sock) or eloop_unregister_read_sock() -- callers (macsec_qca_hapd_init) then os_free(drv) and return NULL, leaking the fd and leaving a stale eloop socket registration alive referencing a socket nobody will ever close. Same shape as the already-documented driver_roboswitch.c fd-leak FN precedent.
